sections.title: WORKOUT
lines: Are You Sick, Well, or Fit? Why You Need to Track Your Health Markers

Fitness isn't a look. It's a capacity. CrossFit defines fitness as the ability to perform well across a wide range of tasks, movements, and time domains, and health as the ability to sustain that capacity for life. Picture a continuum running from sickness to wellness to fitness. Where you sit on it determines your buffer against disease. Track the numbers that matter: blood sugar, lipid profiles, and performance markers. Then use what you learn. Every healthy behavior you adopt moves you further up the continuum, building the vitality and resilience that keep decrepitude at bay.

sections.title: WORKOUT
lines: Optimal Nutrition: The Goalpost Doesn't Move

Everyone's got an opinion on food. Ours hasn't changed in 25 years, because it works. Food quality and quantity. Activity levels. Strategies that hold up for everyday athletes, elite competitors, and anyone managing chronic disease. This episode digs into all of it. No trends. No gimmicks. Just what the science and hundreds of thousands of CrossFit athletes have proven. And if you want to learn even more about how to dial in your nutrition or help others do the same, check out our Applied Nutrition courses near you.
